initialExam.title: DSSSB TGT Teacher 2026
initialExam.description: DSSSB TGT recruitment for Delhi government schools. Good opportunity for teachers wanting to work in Delhi.
initialExam.syllabus: General Awareness (20Q), General Intelligence & Reasoning (20Q), Arithmetical & Numerical Ability (20Q), Hindi Language (20Q), English Language (20Q), Subject concerned (100Q).
initialExam.examPattern: Tier-I: 200 questions, 200 marks, 2 hours. One-tier exam.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Written Exam → Document Verification → Final Selection
initialExam.careerGrowth: TGT → PGT → Vice Principal → Principal in Delhi schools.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit dsssbonline.nic.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA (Delhi rates), Medical, Vacation, Transport Allowance
